items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:210:1
items.html:
And after their being clothed, they are included: it is found that since these are the discernment of HGT, they gave power in the HGT of the externality, which are the HGT that are in NHY, and so on, in this manner: Hesed in Netzah, Hesed in Hesed, Hesed in Hochma etc.: For through the coming of the Partzuf of nursing, which is the discernment of the level that came out on phase one, which is the level of Ruach-Nefesh — this new level clothes within the internality of the Partzuf of the Ibur — these two Partzufim are found included one within the other, and the Partzuf of the Ibur received the discernment of HGT from the Partzuf of nursing, and therefore the middle vessels of the Partzuf of the Ibur also grew, which are the second thirds within it, called HGT. In such a way that there are now, in the right line, two thirds, which are from the NHY of the time of the Ibur, and from the HGT of now, at the time of nursing. And it is found that added to the third of the Sefira of Hochma, which is the Netzah of Hochma that it had at the time of the Ibur, is one further third, which is the Hesed of the Sefira of Hochma. And likewise added to the Netzah that is in Hesed is one further third, the Hesed of Hesed; and likewise added to the Netzah that is in the Sefira of Netzah is one further third, which is the Hesed of Netzah. And with this, each and every Sefira in the right line attained three new thirds: Hesed of Hochma, and Hesed of Hesed, and Hesed of Netzah, in addition to the three old thirds of the time of the Ibur, which are: Netzah of Hochma, and Netzah of Hesed, and Netzah of Netzah. And it now has two thirds in its Hochma, which are Netzah and Hesed of Hochma. And two thirds in its Hesed, which are Netzah and Hesed of Hesed. And two thirds in its Netzah, which are Netzah and Hesed that are in Netzah.
And likewise in the left line, where it had there from the time of the Ibur only the bottom third of each Sefira, which are Hod of Bina, and Hod of Gevura, and Hod of Hod. And there was added to it now, from the Partzuf of nursing, the middle third in each one of them, which are Gevura of Bina, and Gevura of Gevura, and Gevura of Hod. And it now has two thirds in Bina, which are Gevura and Hod of Bina. And two thirds in Gevura, which are Gevura and Hod of Gevura. And two thirds in Hod, which are Gevura and Hod of Hod. And likewise in the middle line of DTY within it, where it had there from the time of the Ibur only Yesod of Daat, and Yesod of Tifferet, and Yesod of Yesod, and there was added to it now, through the Partzuf of nursing, also the middle thirds, which are: Tifferet of Daat, and Tifferet of Tifferet, and Tifferet of Yesod. And it now has two thirds, Tifferet and Yesod, in the Sefira of Daat, and two thirds, Tifferet and Yesod, in the Sefira of Tifferet, and two thirds, Tifferet and Yesod, in the Sefira of Yesod.
